summary: On May 6 the S&P 500 closed at record 7,365.12 (+1.46%), Nasdaq +2% to 25,838.94. On May 7 markets dipped ~0.4% as oil rebounded. Key drivers: Iran peace deal progress (14-point memorandum), AI/semiconductor earnings beats (AMD +17.77%, Supermicro +24.5%), Dow crossed 50,000. Market mood: cautiously bullish with geopolitical tail risk from Iran war.
